causa: Reintentos de PostgREST v14 por 40001: conflicto de revisión tratado como serialización transitoria

procesos.consulta: WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_modo", "p_motivo", "p_revision" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_modo" text, "p_motivo" text, "p_revision" integer) LIMIT 1) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "crm"."recorrido_configurar_fn"("p_modo" := pgrst_body."p_modo", "p_motivo" := pgrst_body."p_motivo", "p_revision" := pgrst_body."p_revision") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT null::bigint AS total_result_set, 1 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->0, 'null') AS body, nullif(current_setting('response.headers', true), '') AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting('response.status', true), '') AS response_status, '' AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "recorrido_configurar_fn".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "recorrido_configurar_fn"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t
